note: Oman: since November 2025 foreign artists and cultural professionals come to live and work temporarily in arts and culture on the cultural visa, for one, five or ten years at 50 rials a year, sponsored by a host such as the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Youth, activated within three months of issue. GCC citizens' position isn't modelled apart. Read from a newspaper's report of the Royal Oman Police's decision.

sources.title: Gulf News, Oman unveils cultural visa to attract global talent (November 2025)
sources.said: has announced the introduction of a cultural visa scheme, with the aim of providing clear legal avenues for foreign nationals to reside and work temporarily within its borders in the fields of arts and culture.
